source_limit: Existing M2 source is synthetic-manual; no professional signed source or clinician approval is invented.

proposed_algorithm.zone: Use entered segment IANA zone; never silently use device/travel zone. A travel adjustment requires a new reviewed decision/source.
proposed_algorithm.dates: Inclusive segment and requested horizon civil dates in entered segment zone.
proposed_algorithm.interval: Require explicit matching absolute UTC minute anchor and explicit elapsed_utc basis; never infer start from an unknown anchor.
proposed_algorithm.dst_weekdays: A gap or fold blocks the complete preview window with zero guessed or partial events.
proposed_algorithm.dst_elapsed_interval: Explicit elapsed_utc proposal preserves elapsed spacing across clock transitions; this interpretation requires clinician review before use.
proposed_algorithm.as_needed_or_mixed: Unsupported for deterministic scheduled events; no guessed frequency.
proposed_algorithm.free_text_or_taper: Preserve entered text/amount. Existing segments have no per-segment dose field; do not derive taper amounts or interpret inconsistent prose. Qualified review/model support remains missing.
proposed_algorithm.clock: Explicit asOf must remain within the selected source admission and not precede observation. No implicit clock, missed-dose catchup or compensation.
proposed_algorithm.amend_stop: Compute immutable obsolete-ID diff; preserve source links/history; actual native cancellation requires approved future adapter.
proposed_algorithm.clock_precision: Minute-aligned UTC anchors/occurrences only. Historical second-based offsets are explicitly unsupported, never rounded into guessed times.

runtime_qualification: Node Intl vectors only. Patient renderer/tzdb parity, physical device/clock policy and platform command registration are unrun/unapproved.
